command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const e=document.querySelector("input,textarea"); if(!e)return "NO_TEXT_INPUT"; e.focus(); return {tag:e.tagName,type:e.type,placeholder:e.placeholder};})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){console.log(JSON.stringify(m.result.result.value));ws.close();}}' && sleep 1; ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys input_method | grep -E 'mInputShown|mIsInputViewShown|mServedInputConnection' | head -20 || true
